2.t: Because the blind man came unto him.

3.t: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

4.t: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?

5.t: As for him who thinketh himself independent,

7.t: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).

8.t: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

11.t: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

12.t: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,

18.t: From what thing doth He create him?

19.t: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,

20.t: Then maketh the way easy for him,

21.t: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;

22.t: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.

23.t: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.

25.t: How We pour water in showers

26.t: Then split the earth in clefts

27.t: And cause the grain to grow therein

32.t: Provision for you and your cattle.

34.t: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

35.t: And his mother and his father

36.t: And his wife and his children,

37.t: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).

38.t: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,

40.t: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,

42.t: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
